title: Thumb String Lab · v0.9.3
changes: Added optional right-thumbstick String Lab using tracked left/right thumb-tip joints (no model inference).
Touch thumb tips for 160 ms to link green endpoints; stretch toward 1 m to shift the thick ribbon from green through yellow/orange to red.
Original WebAudio elastic-string tone increases in pitch with distance and ends in a synthesized pop when the strand snaps.
Snapped fragments hang briefly from thumb joints, fall with simulated gravity, fade, then require the hands to separate before reattachment.
Runs only in immersive WebXR; automatically silences the oscillator on tracking loss, lab disable, or XR exit.
All existing captures, API keys, model routes, database and watcher remain unchanged.
